null_rung.note: The identity rung runs the whole injection path rather than short-circuiting, so a non-zero reading here would be a defect in the ladder, not an effect.

positive_control_homogeneous_margins.note: Margins made deliberately homogeneous across the same 5 blocks. It clears the bar, so n=5 and the separation path are NOT what fails below.

proportional_closure_ceiling.note: Separation of a proportional-closure arm from the reference. Independent of the fraction closed BY CONSTRUCTION, so it is a ceiling for that whole family of arms.

d6_registry_guard.registry_refusal: 'stage_decay' is not in C6_METRICS, so nothing has ruled on whether it may decide the stage experiment. An unregistered metric is an unchecked metric; register it with a direction and a gate_eligible flag before letting it decide anything.

not_a_verdict: NOT A VERDICT. D3 (known-beta recovery) passes and D4 (MDE at 2.0 block-SD, n=5) FAILS, so this channel is not licensed to adjudicate anything, and the C6 registry independently refuses it (see d6_registry_guard). Every number here is a property of the INSTRUMENT or of arm A as already published; no architecture arm was built, trained or scored.
